bind_host.description: IP address to bind the DHCP agent API server to. Use 0.0.0.0 to listen on all interfaces.

api_workers.description: Number of worker processes for the DHCP agent API server. Set to 0 to disable the API server.

maxdhcpdevices.description: Maximum number of DHCP agents that can serve a given network. Increases fault tolerance but adds overhead.

enable_isolated_metadata.description: Enable metadata proxy for isolated networks (e.g., tenant networks without routers). Required for instance metadata access in such cases.

enable_metadata_proxy.description: Enable metadata proxy on shared networks. Allows instances to access the Neutron metadata service via a proxy.

dhcp_leasefs.description: Base directory for DHCP lease files managed by the agent.

dhcp_leasefile.description: Path to the shared dnsmasq leases file used for tracking DHCP assignments.

domain.description: DNS domain to assign to instances (e.g., openstack.local). Used for hostname resolution inside VMs.

dhcp_broadcast.description: Enable DHCP broadcast replies. Set to false for unicast-only environments (e.g., some cloud environments).

enable_dnsmasq_dns.description: Enable DNS functionality in dnsmasq for instances. Disabling may break name resolution in VMs.

mtu_set.description: Enable --mtu-set in dnsmasq. Requires dnsmasq >= 2.67. Sets the interface MTU via DHCP.

dns_servers.description: List of DNS server IPs to provide to instances via DHCP. If empty, uses DNS servers configured on the subnet.

items.description: Custom DHCP options in format: tag:<tag>,<code>,<value> (e.g., tag:pxe,6,8.8.8.8). Used for advanced provisioning.

extra_dhcp_opts.description: List of extra DHCP options to pass to dnsmasq. Useful for PXE boot, vendor-specific parameters, etc.

dnsmasq_config_dir.description: Directory containing per-network dnsmasq configuration files. Allows per-subnet customization.

enable_dnsmasq_cache.description: Enable DNS query caching in dnsmasq. Improves DNS resolution performance for repeated lookups.

log_level.description: Logging verbosity level for the DHCP agent.

log_dir.description: Directory where log files are stored for the DHCP agent.

heartbeat_interval.description: Seconds between heartbeat messages sent to the Neutron server. Set to 0 to disable heartbeats (not recommended).

dhcp_driver.description: DHCP driver class to use for managing DHCP services (e.g., dnsmasq).

use_external_dhcp.description: Use external DHCP servers instead of Neutron-managed dnsmasq for certain networks (e.g., provider networks).

metadata_port.description: Port used by the metadata proxy to forward instance requests to the Neutron metadata service.

gateway_in_dns.description: Include gateway (router) IP in DHCP responses as option 3.

host_routes_in_dns.description: Include host routes in DHCP responses as option 121 (classless static routes).

domain_in_dns.description: Include domain name in DHCP responses as option 15.

mtu_in_dns.description: Include interface MTU in DHCP responses as option 26. Requires dnsmasq >= 2.67.

ntp_servers_in_dns.description: Include NTP server IPs in DHCP responses as option 42.

static_routes_in_dns.description: Include static routes in DHCP responses as option 121 (alias of host_routes_in_dns).

lease_time.description: Default DHCP lease time in seconds (e.g., 86400 for 24 hours).

subnet_mask_in_dns.description: Include subnet mask in DHCP responses as option 1.

broadcast_in_dns.description: Include broadcast address in DHCP responses as option 28.

router_in_dns.description: Alias for gateway_in_dns (include router as option 3).

classless_route_in_dns.description: Include classless static routes (option 121) — modern replacement for option 33.

vendor_class_in_dns.description: Include vendor class identifier (option 60) — used for PXE boot device identification.

user_class_in_dns.description: Include user class identifier (option 77) — for client-side classification.

firmware_in_dns.description: Include firmware version (option 93) — for PXE boot device firmware info.

location_in_dns.description: Include location option (option 112) — for geolocation or rack-aware provisioning.

netboot_in_dns.description: Include netboot option (option 209) — for iPXE/HTTP boot support.

pxeserver_in_dns.description: Include PXE server option (option 66/67) — for legacy PXE boot servers.

tftp_in_dns.description: Include TFTP server option — used for network boot.

initfile_in_dns.description: Include init file name (option 50) — used for some bootloaders.

rootpath_in_dns.description: Include root path (option 17) — for diskless boot.
